stories.h: M.Harris Passes Insley, Owns the Single-Season Receiving Record
stories.d: [[p:557727604|M.Harris]] now has 2,087 receiving yards. That is past the 2,060 that stood as the real-life FBS mark, set by Trevor Insley of Nevada in 1999. Expect his phone to keep ringing in the portal.

quote.text: Every defense knows where he's going. It doesn't matter.
quote.by: a rival defensive staffer

stories.h: Boise State Goes for It Four Times, Gets Burned by Ohio State
stories.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] converted two of four fourth-down tries against [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] and handed the ball back on downs twice. The analytics crowd will defend it. Boosters who left early were not buying it.

quote.text: You can be aggressive and still have a punter. Nobody on that sideline wanted to hear that, though.
quote.by: a person close to the Boise State program

stories.h: Penn State's Thin Backfield Could Be Its Best Pitch to J. Davis
stories.d: Arkansas holds a slight lead for [[r:561124414|J. Davis]], with Florida still in the mix. His dealbreaker is playing time, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has one returning running back. A source says the Nittany Lions staff has leaned hard on that.

quote.text: He wants to see the field as a freshman. Penn State can show him a depth chart and say, 'Look.'
quote.by: a source close to the recruiting process

stories.h: Notre Dame's Pro Pipeline Gives It a Shot With J. Droogsma
stories.d: [[t:832438277|Arizona State]] leads for four-star receiver [[r:561119710|J. Droogsma]], but [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] is closing on pro potential, his dealbreaker. The Irish have sent five receivers to the draft in four years. Minnesota is hanging around.

quote.text: He keeps asking about the draft. Notre Dame keeps handing him names.
quote.by: a person familiar with his thinking

stories.h: Gillikin Wants a Title Shot, and Nebraska Is Selling One
stories.d: Indiana still leads for [[r:561122612|B. Gillikin]], but [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] is gaining because he wants a contender. The Huskers grade out an A- there. Florida State is still lurking.

quote.text: Every visit, he asks the same thing: can I win a ring here?
quote.by: a high school coach familiar with the process

stories.h: Texas Tech Lands Four-Star Linebacker M. Chukwurah on Title Pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] earned an A+ for championship contention, and [[r:561125824|M. Chukwurah]] wanted a shot at a title. The Red Raiders also rank 6th nationally in pro potential at linebacker, with a first-round pick in the last four years.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.
quote.by: M. Chukwurah

stories.h: D. Lowe Picks Notre Dame Over Michigan and Miami
stories.d: [[r:561124482|D. Lowe]] chose [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] because of the coaching staff, which earned an A+ for prestige. The Irish also rank 5th nationally in pro potential at offensive line. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438337|Miami]] came up short.

quote.text: You trust the guys who've done it. This staff has done it.
quote.by: D. Lowe

stories.h: TCU Lands Four-Star Receiver J. Fabuluje, Who Says He Wants Rings
stories.d: [[r:561123302|J. Fabuluje]] picked [[t:832438381|TCU]] after seeing an A-grade title contender whose offense ranks 15th in receptions with 229. For a playmaking receiver, that is a good setup.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.
quote.by: J. Fabuluje

stories.h: Rivalry Win Over Auburn Seals It: K. Bacon Picks Alabama
stories.d: [[r:561119293|K. Bacon]] chose [[t:832438274|Alabama]] over [[t:832438339|Michigan]] and [[t:832438278|Arkansas]]. He watched Alabama's 50-31 rivalry win over [[t:832438281|Auburn]] from the stands, and a source says the visit effectively closed it.

quote.text: That win over Auburn? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.
quote.by: K. Bacon

stories.h: B.Lyle Was Supposed to Leave Ohio State. He Stayed
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] spent two weeks on Portal Watch, buried on the depth chart and about to get expensive after a rating jump. Now the portal is open and he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. A source says the staff pushed hard to keep him.

quote.text: That one was closer than people think.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: R.Gado Stays at Ohio State Despite Depth Chart Noise
stories.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] spent two weeks on Portal Watch, stuck on the depth chart. He is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Tuddy_roosevelt still has to show him a clearer path to playing time.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: K.Bing Stays at Ohio State, and the Pay Question Stays Too
stories.d: [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] was on Portal Watch for a week because he is underpaid for his rating. He did not enter the portal, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] kept him for now. A raise could still come up.

quote.text: He's happy. But he knows his number, and he'd like the staff to know it too.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: K.Gebhardt Skips the Portal at Ohio State
stories.d: [[p:557724533|K.Gebhardt]] spent a week on Portal Watch as underpaid for his rating. The portal is open and he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster, even as teammates head out.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: Army Keeps R.Hopkins After Money Talks
stories.d: Portal Watch had [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] as a likely departure. He played on a losing team and drew criticism for his numbers. [[t:832438280|Army]] bumped his NIL from 205K to 300K, and he is still on the roster.

quote.text: Honestly, I thought he was gone. The staff went to work on him.
quote.by: a team source

stories.h: A.Gafford Stays at Penn State After Rating Jump
stories.d: [[p:557724319|A.Gafford]] was on Portal Watch because his rating jump made him expensive. With the portal open, he is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster. A source says agerm40's staff kept him in the loop.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

stories.h: J.Blue Is Still an Ohio State Buckeye
stories.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] for a week because his rating jump was about to make him expensive. He is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open.

quote.text: Nothing changed on our end. He's been solid all offseason.
quote.by: a person close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: Ohio State Holds Onto S.Wisne as Teammates Depart
stories.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] was on Portal Watch for a week as a rising-rating, rising-cost player. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] kept him off the portal list. Several teammates were not so lucky.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the Ohio State program

stories.h: N.Pullard Stays at Penn State Despite Scheme Concerns
stories.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] for a week as a bad fit for the scheme. He is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, a small win for agerm40 while two four-stars did leave.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a person close to the player

stories.h: M.Carver Stays at Penn State After a Week on the Watch
stories.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] was on Portal Watch because of a scheme fit concern. The portal is open and he remains on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster, so the secondary rebuild has a little more to work with.

quote.text: There were conversations. He's comfortable with where it landed.
quote.by: a source close to the Penn State program

stories.h: Stanford Loses 11 to the Portal as Harrell Arrives
stories.d: Eleven players entered the portal from [[t:832438379|Stanford]]. That includes tackles Devon Todia and Marquez Lett and receiver Jalen Gibbs. None are four-stars or better, but the new coaching change is the obvious backdrop.

quote.text: Some guys wanted to see what the new staff looked like. Others didn't wait.
quote.by: a source close to the Stanford program

stories.h: Ohio State Loses Four, Including Three Blue-Chip Defenders
stories.d: Safety Cortez Gaydosh, cornerback Daniel Wilkes and linebacker Layne Wayne are among four players to leave [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Tuddy_roosevelt has to replace three four- or five-star players, mostly on defense.

quote.text: That's a lot of snaps walking out the door in one phase.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: Penn State Loses Tackle Truman and Edge Durbin to the Portal
stories.d: Four-star tackle Konrad Truman and four-star edge rusher Tory Durbin are on the way out of [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. agerm40 now has to rebuild the lines before the next window closes.

quote.text: You lose two guys up front like that, and the recruiting pitch has to change.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: J.Slay Leaves Bowling Green After a Week on the Watch List
stories.d: TD Wire flagged [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] as underpaid for his rating. He is now in the portal, leaving a hole at [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]]. Mid-major budgets rarely beat this kind of gap.

stories.h: T.Crethers Hits the Portal, Leaving Colorado With a Hole
stories.d: [[p:557727223|T.Crethers]] spent a week on Portal Watch, under fire for his numbers. He is now in the transfer portal, and [[t:832438295|Colorado]] has to find a replacement.

stories.h: K.Largent Leaves Miami for the Portal
stories.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557715676|K.Largent]] for a week because he was under fire for his numbers. He is now gone from [[t:832438337|Miami]], and the production questions followed him out.

stories.h: D.Peters Exits Army, a Day After the Hopkins Win
stories.d: [[p:557728277|D.Peters]] hit the portal after a week on the watch list for under-the-radar numbers. [[t:832438280|Army]] kept R.Hopkins but lost Peters, a mixed result for the staff.

stories.h: G.Lovelace Enters the Portal, Leaving Florida Thin
stories.d: [[p:557716595|G.Lovelace]] spent a week on Portal Watch, under fire for his numbers. He is now in the portal, leaving [[t:832438308|Florida]] with a hole to fill.

stories.h: Rival Collectives Circle Oregon's J.Curtis, a 93-Overall QB Making Nothing
stories.d: [[p:557727240|J.Curtis]] is a 93-overall quarterback with no NIL money, while similar players earn around 260K. Collectives are circling. [[t:832438364|Oregon]] has deep pockets, 9th nationally, which may be its best defense.

quote.text: Everybody knows what he's worth. It's a matter of who's willing to say it first.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: N.Grubbs Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557724658|N.Grubbs]], a 91-overall quarterback, makes nothing in NIL while peers earn around 235K. Collectives know the gap closes fast in the portal.

quote.text: There's no way he stays at zero. Somebody's going to fix that.
quote.by: a source familiar with his situation

stories.h: A.Noriega's Pay Gap Has Quarterback-Needy Contenders Lining Up, Penn State Included
stories.d: [[p:557726587|A.Noriega]] is a 92-overall quarterback making 115K, while comparable passers get around 260K. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is being mentioned as a landing spot, and the market will probably correct itself fast.

quote.text: A guy rated that high at that position isn't staying at that number once the window opens. Somebody will call, and somebody will pay.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: D.Berymon Is Playing for Free at Texas. That Won't Last
stories.d: [[p:557726991|D.Berymon]] is a 91-overall defensive tackle with no NIL deal, though comparable players get around 220K. [[t:832438384|Texas]] has the 10th-deepest NIL pockets in the country, so it has room to fix this before somebody else tries.

quote.text: You don't leave a guy like that unpaid and expect nobody to notice. Everybody has noticed.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: G.Priester Is Too Good for a 4-8 Minnesota Team, and Everyone Knows It
stories.d: [[p:557716293|G.Priester]] is a 92-overall junior receiver stuck on a losing team. Contenders have already circled his name, and Minnesota may have a hard time convincing him that next year looks different.

quote.text: He's a first-call guy. Every offense in the country with a hole at receiver has his number saved.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: D.Bojorquez's Rating Says 86. His Field Goal Misses Say Otherwise
stories.d: Making only 6 of 12 field goals is a problem for a ranked team. [[p:557717000|D.Bojorquez]] may have to fend off competition this offseason, and the staff reportedly isn't comfortable going into next year on faith.

quote.text: Nobody doubts the leg. It's the misses that people remember in close games, and that's what the staff keeps coming back to.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Florida Is Weighing a Quarterback Change as C.Keener's Production Lags
stories.d: [[p:557715200|C.Keener]] threw 12 touchdowns against 11 interceptions on 248-of-423 passing for 3153 yards. That's a 125.4 rating, and it has [[t:832438308|Florida]] debating whether an 87-overall quarterback is still the answer.

quote.text: The ratings are good. The results are what people are talking about, and the conversations aren't quiet anymore.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: C.Diabate Was Supposed to Be a Star. Now He Has to Earn His Job
stories.d: [[p:557726463|C.Diabate]] had 17 catches for 276 yards in 14 games, which isn't enough for an 85-overall receiver on a ranked team. He'll go into camp fighting for his spot, and younger receivers are reportedly pushing him.

quote.text: Nobody is handing him anything this summer. He has to show he's the guy everyone thought he was.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Show him the money: the 10 biggest NIL raises of the offseason
stories.d: $2.25 million in new money across the top 10. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557727807|A.Jones]]: 0K to 285K.

stories.h: Coming for your Saturdays: this year's breakout candidates
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: Harrell Leaves East Carolina for Stanford, and Pirates Players Take Notice
stories.d: [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] goes from [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] to a [[t:832438379|Stanford]] program that is 10-3 and ranked No. 18. He leaves behind a 19-19 record in Greenville and a locker room that learned about it fast.

quote.text: Guys found out on their phones. Nobody's mad at the opportunity, but the timing stings.
quote.by: a source close to the East Carolina program

stories.h: Nebraska Stuns No. 7 TCU Despite Getting Outgained
stories.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] gave up more yards than it gained and still sent [[t:832438381|TCU]] tumbling. Three forced turnovers made the difference, and the Horned Frogs will drop in the polls.

quote.text: We didn't win the stat sheet. We won the football game.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

stories.h: Boise State Rolls Texas, and Longhorn Fans Want Answers
stories.d: [[t:832438284|Boise State]] outgained and outplayed No. 8 [[t:832438384|Texas]] in a 37-20 win. Burnt-orange boosters were already grumbling about the team's big-game form, and a drop in the polls won't calm them.

quote.text: That wasn't a fluke. They were just tougher than us.
quote.by: a Texas staffer, speaking anonymously

stories.h: TCU's Fourth-Down Gamble Backfires, and Fans Are Furious
stories.d: [[t:832438381|TCU]] went 3-for-6 on fourth down and turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438348|Nebraska]]. The analytics crowd will defend every call. Fans won't, and the postgame mood suggests some players had doubts too.

quote.text: You can be aggressive without handing them the ball in your own territory.
quote.by: a person familiar with TCU's postgame mood

stories.h: Middle Tennessee Topples New Mexico and Puts Its Coach on Radars
stories.d: Unranked [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]] beat No. 23 [[t:832438350|New Mexico]] 28-17 despite being outgained. Bigger programs notice wins like this, and the rankings committee will have to deal with it this week.

quote.text: People are going to start asking who is running that program.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

stories.h: Kansas State Embarrasses Colorado State in Statement Win
stories.d: [[t:832438325|Kansas State]] beat No. 25 [[t:832438296|Colorado State]] 51-7, forced three turnovers, and left the Rams' locker room quiet and the booster chatter loud. Colorado State will fall in the polls.

quote.text: That was a beatdown from the first series on.
quote.by: a Colorado State staffer

stories.h: Texas Tech Survives Washington in Overtime Thriller
stories.d: [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] edged [[t:832438408|Washington]] 57-55 after taking the extra period 15-13. Neither sideline could breathe at the end, and one Huskies source said the defense will be the topic all offseason.

quote.text: Nobody on our side wanted to see another snap of defense.
quote.by: a person close to the Washington program

stories.h: K.Osborne's Seven Touchdowns Can't Save Washington in Heartbreaker
stories.d: [[p:557719497|K.Osborne]] threw for 365 yards and seven scores in the 57-55 overtime loss to [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]]. Rival staffs noticed. His night made a strong case for him, even in defeat.

quote.text: He did everything he could. The rest of us have to be better.
quote.by: a Washington teammate

stories.h: New Mexico's Fourth-Down Bets Come Up Short Against Middle Tennessee
stories.d: [[t:832438350|New Mexico]] went 2-for-4 on fourth down, and both misses turned into momentum for [[t:832438341|Middle Tennessee]]. The analytics side will say go for it. The fan base is not in a forgiving mood.

quote.text: Take the points once in a while. That's all I'm asking.
quote.by: a New Mexico booster

stories.h: Oregon State's Aggression Hands Oklahoma the Edge
stories.d: [[t:832438365|Oregon State]] was stopped twice on fourth down against [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], going 2-for-4 overall. Fans can live with bold coaching, but not when it keeps handing the ball to the other side.

quote.text: The call is fine. The execution wasn't.
quote.by: a source close to the Oregon State program

stories.h: N.Grubbs Torches Wake Forest as Florida State Pulls Away
stories.d: [[p:557724658|N.Grubbs]] threw for 412 yards and went 30-of-39 without a pick in a 35-24 [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]] loss. The Demon Deacons' secondary had no answer, and the Seminoles looked comfortable all afternoon.

quote.text: He saw everything. We couldn't get him off rhythm.
quote.by: a Wake Forest defensive player

stories.h: Syracuse Edges Baylor in Overtime as Bears Wonder What Slipped Away
stories.d: [[t:832438380|Syracuse]] beat [[t:832438283|Baylor]] 44-41 after taking the extra period 10-7. Baylor had chances to close it out, and the sideline frustration was visible.

quote.text: We had it. We let it get away.
quote.by: a Baylor player, speaking after the game

stories.h: C.Emanuel's Three Interceptions Sink Colorado State
stories.d: [[p:557727365|C.Emanuel]] threw three picks in the 51-7 loss to [[t:832438325|Kansas State]]. Many of them were into coverage, and one source said coaches questioned some of his reads on the sideline.

quote.text: He forced it. Everybody saw it.
quote.by: a Colorado State staffer

stories.h: R.Wise Shreds Miami for 469 Yards in Ole Miss Rout
stories.d: [[p:557728796|R.Wise]] was 29-of-37 with no interceptions in a 50-31 win over [[t:832438337|Miami]]. He made it look easy, and Hurricanes defenders left the field with their heads down.

quote.text: He picked us apart and we couldn't stop it.
quote.by: a Miami defensive player

stories.h: L.Nickel Throws for 419 as Mississippi State Escapes by a Point
stories.d: [[p:557719284|L.Nickel]] threw for 419 yards in Mississippi State's 34-33 win over [[t:832438354|North Texas]]. The interception was ugly, but he delivered when it counted, and the Mean Green are left to wonder what might have been.

quote.text: That was too close. We'll take it.
quote.by: a Mississippi State teammate

stories.h: Q.Rambo's Three Picks Doom UNLV Against Wyoming
stories.d: [[p:557717254|Q.Rambo]] threw three interceptions in the [[t:832438414|Wyoming]] win. [[t:832438397|UNLV]] never recovered, and the quarterback's confidence in the pocket looked shaky all afternoon.

quote.text: He kept pressing. It got worse each series.
quote.by: a person close to the UNLV program

stories.h: Buffalo Outlasts Coastal Carolina in Low-Scoring Overtime Grinder
stories.d: [[t:832438287|Buffalo]] took the extra period 3-0 to beat [[t:832438294|Coastal Carolina]] 19-16. It was a defensive slugfest that ended on a field goal, and the Chanticleers were left frustrated on offense.

quote.text: It was ugly, and I'll take ugly all day.
quote.by: a Buffalo source

stories.h: J.Faulk Wrecks Southern Miss With Three Sacks in Colorado Win
stories.d: [[p:557714739|J.Faulk]] racked up three sacks and three tackles for loss in Colorado's 41-33 win over [[t:832438378|Southern Mississippi]]. Scouts are paying attention, and the Golden Eagles' line had no answer.

quote.text: He was in our backfield all night.
quote.by: a Southern Miss offensive lineman

stories.h: C.Metzner Terrorizes Louisiana With Three Sacks in UAB Rout
stories.d: [[p:557728102|C.Metzner]] had three sacks and nine tackles in UAB's 38-10 win over [[t:832438330|Louisiana]]. The Ragin' Cajuns' protection broke down and the quarterback never got comfortable.

quote.text: We couldn't block him. Simple as that.
quote.by: a Louisiana coach, speaking anonymously

stories.h: Miami (OH) Flagged 13 Times in Loss to Toledo
stories.d: [[t:832438338|Miami University]] was penalized 13 times for 100 yards against [[t:832438388|Toledo]]. Expect discipline to dominate practice this week, and one source said the staff's patience is thin.

quote.text: It's never the other team that beats us. It's us.
quote.by: a source close to the Miami University program

stories.h: Eastern Michigan's Four Turnovers Hand Western Kentucky the Win
stories.d: [[t:832438300|Eastern Michigan]] gave it away four times and [[t:832438411|Western Kentucky]] cashed in. Staffers say the ball security problems are not new, and the coaches know it.

quote.text: You can't win like that. We know it.
quote.by: an Eastern Michigan assistant

stories.h: Kennesaw State's Sloppy Day Gives Georgia State a Gift
stories.d: [[t:832438326|Kennesaw State]] turned it over four times in the loss to [[t:832438314|Georgia State]], and the Panthers cashed in. The Owls left the field wondering how a day got away like that.

quote.text: We beat ourselves. That's all there is to it.
quote.by: a Kennesaw State player

stories.h: Clemson Buries Fresno State as Bulldogs Face a Long Film Session
stories.d: [[t:832438293|Clemson]] piled up 476 yards in a 41-6 rout of [[t:832438311|Fresno State]]. The Bulldogs never found their footing, and one source said the film session will be tough.

quote.text: We got outcoached and outplayed. It happens.
quote.by: a source close to the Fresno State program

stories.h: C.Keener Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Say Otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557715200|C.Keener]], an 87-overall quarterback, has 12 touchdowns and 11 interceptions. His rating doesn't match his billing, and the staff has a big offseason decision on its hands.

quote.text: There are real questions about whether the production matches the rating.
quote.by: a person familiar with the program

stories.h: T.Crethers has the 88 rating but not the stat line to match
stories.d: [[p:557727223|T.Crethers]] finished with 21 catches for 303 yards in 9 games. The staff faces a real offseason decision on whether he is the answer or just a name on the roster.

quote.text: He looks the part in warmups. Then Saturday comes and the ball just isn't finding him.
quote.by: a rival defensive staffer

stories.h: Is Wake Forest Ready to Move On From D.Bojorquez?
stories.d: [[p:557717000|D.Bojorquez]] hit just 6 of 12 field goals for [[t:832438407|Wake Forest]], and a ranked team can't live with that. Sources say the staff is weighing kicking competition this offseason.

quote.text: You can't have that number in a close game.
quote.by: a Wake Forest source

stories.h: B.Lyle Is an 89-Overall Quarterback Watching From Ohio State's Sideline
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] has taken 8 snaps in 12 games, and the sophomore's camp is reportedly wondering how long he can stay in the No. 2 role. Quarterback-needy programs are already doing their homework.

quote.text: He's too talented to be holding a clipboard. Somebody's going to offer him a job, and it'll be a real one.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J.Daulton Is a 90-Overall Quarterback Who Hasn't Taken a Snap
stories.d: Thirteen games, zero snaps for the junior. Contenders with a hole under center have noticed, and [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] may be the most intriguing name on the board if he enters the portal. He also complicates the F.Brandon conversation.

quote.text: You don't see a 90 at quarterback sitting around very often. Staffs will be calling the minute the window opens.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: R.Gado Keeps Playing at Ohio State but Can't Crack the Top Spot
stories.d: The sophomore tackle has logged 81 snaps in 12 games, yet he's still stuck at No. 2. Tuddy_roosevelt hasn't fixed this depth chart problem, and a team that would start [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] right away could make the decision for him.

quote.text: He's earned reps. He's not being told he's the guy, and at some point that matters.
quote.by: a person familiar with Gado's thinking

stories.h: R.Hopkins Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Numbers Say Otherwise
stories.d: The 90-overall [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] has 8 interceptions to 5 touchdowns across 140 attempts. Coaches may look at quarterbacks in the portal, and people close to the program say the staff is already preparing for that.

quote.text: The ratings and the production don't match. Everyone sees it.
quote.by: a person familiar with the program's thinking

stories.h: Ratings Say 88. The Stat Sheet Says Something Else for K.Largent
stories.d: [[p:557715676|K.Largent]] has 31 catches for 433 yards in 13 games. An 88-overall receiver should be doing more, and a source says he has started asking about his role and may want options elsewhere.

quote.text: He wants the ball and wants to produce. That's it.
quote.by: a source close to Largent

stories.h: D.Peters Hasn't Delivered at Army, and the Offseason Clock Is Ticking
stories.d: Eight catches for 167 yards in eight games is far from what an 86-overall receiver should produce. The staff has to decide whether [[p:557728277|D.Peters]] gets a bigger role or whether the portal opens a different door.

quote.text: There's talent there, no question. Right now it's about whether the fit is right for him and for them.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: M.Cobb Could Be the Portal's Top Prize Out of a 4-8 Notre Dame Team
stories.d: The 89-overall junior middle linebacker is playing for a Notre Dame team that went 4-8, and contenders have taken note. Several staffs are expected to call [[p:557715009|M.Cobb]] the moment the window opens.

quote.text: Every contender with a hole at middle linebacker is going to be on the phone with him.
quote.by: a rival defensive coordinator

stories.h: G.Lovelace Was Billed as a Star Back, and the Staff Faces a Decision
stories.d: Sixty-six carries for 259 yards, just 3.9 a carry, isn't what you want from an 85-overall back. The staff has a big decision to make this offseason on [[p:557716595|G.Lovelace]], whether to stick with him or bring in competition.

quote.text: He's not a bust, but he's not what they thought they were getting. That makes the decision harder.
quote.by: a person close to the program

stories.h: D.Smith Is an 88-Overall Receiver on a 4-8 Minnesota Team, and Contenders Are Calling
stories.d: The junior receiver is stuck on a Minnesota team that went 4-8. His name is circulating among contenders, which is bad timing for a staff trying to sell J. Lindsay on its passing game. [[p:557728494|D.Smith]] could leave.

quote.text: Every contender knows who he is. Minnesota knows it too, and it's got to be uncomfortable.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: A.Hurley is a 90-overall receiver who barely shows up in the box score
stories.d: Five catches for 57 yards in three games is thin production for [[p:557718668|A.Hurley]], who has top-tier ratings and a spot on a ranked team. Insiders say the target share isn't there. Another quiet month will invite louder questions about the offense and his future.

quote.text: He's a talented kid who isn't getting the ball. Eventually that becomes a conversation about where he'd be happier.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: East Carolina's 13-0 run has the Pirates believing, and Harrell is selling it
stories.d: [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] is 13-0 and up to No. 2 in the poll. Per a source close to the program, [[c:H0ldStillPlease|Coach Harrell]] has kept the locker room almost boringly even through all of it.

quote.text: One week at a time. Corny, but it works.
quote.by: Coach Harrell

stories.h: Penn State's thin backfield is its pitch to HB Lehan, and Arkansas knows it
stories.d: Four-star HB [[r:561122840|M. Lehan]] wants snaps, and [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has one returning back. That gives it a slight lead over [[t:832438278|Arkansas]], with Georgia lurking. Official visits will likely settle it.

quote.text: He keeps asking who's actually in the room ahead of him. Penn State's answer is a short list.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: BYU's pass-heavy pitch has Minnesota looking over its shoulder for J. Lindsay
stories.d: Minnesota still holds the lead for [[r:561122258|J. Lindsay]], but playing style is his dealbreaker. [[t:832438288|BYU]] is selling a passing game that fits a route runner. SMU is lurking, and official visits could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to be a featured piece in the offense. That's the whole conversation right now.
quote.by: a person close to the recruit

stories.h: Nguyen wants to play early, and Minnesota is telling him he will
stories.d: Minnesota has the edge for T. Nguyen, but playing time is the dealbreaker. SMU is pushing, and Tennessee is lurking with a deep-roster pitch. Official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He's not interested in a redshirt year. He's said that to everybody.
quote.by: a source close to the recruitment

stories.h: Minnesota leads for Turpin, but Texas Tech is pitching the NFL hard
stories.d: Pro potential is what matters to J. Turpin, and Texas Tech is chasing Minnesota with a development pitch. SMU sits well back but hasn't gone away. Expect both staffs to push everything they have this week.

quote.text: Every call with Texas Tech comes back to the next level. They know what he's listening for.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: Pounds wants to stay close to home, and that's a problem for Minnesota
stories.d: [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] leads for four-star WR [[r:561123834|R. Pounds]], but proximity to home is the dealbreaker. That keeps [[t:832438375|SMU]] and TCU in play. Somebody's heart gets broken on signing day.

quote.text: His mom wants him within driving distance. That's not a small thing in this house.
quote.by: a source close to the family

stories.h: Droege is chasing exposure, and SMU barely leads Iowa
stories.d: Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for C. Droege. SMU has a slight edge on Iowa, which isn't going quietly, and Arkansas is lurking. Minnesota fans may notice SMU's name keeps showing up on its board.

quote.text: Iowa thinks the visit changes everything. SMU thinks the TV schedule does.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Quarterman's 11-point jump leaves East Carolina with an NIL problem
stories.d: The junior receiver is up to 80 overall and earning nothing in NIL. [[p:557725851|D.Quarterman]] and [[t:832438301|East Carolina]] may need to talk soon, because bigger programs will be watching film.

quote.text: Guys notice when a teammate jumps like that. So do other collectives.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Gafford is a 90 now, and Penn State's offense has a star to keep
stories.d: [[p:557724319|A.Gafford]] jumped to 90 overall, and the sophomore receiver now earns above the going rate. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] has more bargaining power than it did last week. Rival programs have taken note.

quote.text: You don't see a jump like that often. Somebody's already asked about him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Ohio State's Blue is a 90 and paid like he's not
stories.d: Sophomore corner [[p:557711879|J.Blue]] is now 90 overall at 110K in NIL, well under the going rate for corners at his level. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has a gap to close before collectives around the country start calling.

quote.text: A corner like that gets calls from places with deeper pockets. It's only a matter of time.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Lyle's rise to 89 sharpens Ohio State's quarterback question
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is up to 89 overall at 280K, which is more than quarterbacks rated like him usually get. But [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has another sophomore rising behind him, and that makes the roster math awkward for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He's earned the money. He's also looking at that depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Wisne's jump to 92 puts Ohio State in a good problem
stories.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] is now 92 overall and earning 290K, a lot for a sophomore. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has two strong young quarterbacks, so Tuddy_roosevelt will have to manage both of them.

quote.text: Both guys know what's happening. They know exactly who's pushing who.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Bing is an 86 making nothing, and Ohio State can't hide it forever
stories.d: Safety [[p:557723757|K.Bing]] is a top bargain in college football. Players at his position and rating make around 90K, and [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]'s ability to ignore that gap is shrinking. This is not a new issue.

quote.text: Everyone knows what he should be making. It's just a question of who calls first.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: N.Pullard is a bump-and-run corner stuck on a defense that gets burned deep
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] is an 88-overall corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 131st of 138 against the pass. Scouts who like his skill set wonder how long he'll stay in a system that doesn't use it.

quote.text: You have a guy built to press and lock down a side of the field, and he's playing in a defense that gives up chunk plays. Other staffs notice that.
quote.by: a rival defensive staffer

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling Ohio State safety Gebhardt
stories.d: [[p:557724533|K.Gebhardt]] is an 84-overall safety making nothing in NIL, and players at his level command around 45K. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has been alerted that other programs are watching.

quote.text: A couple of people have already asked about him. That's usually how it starts.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Priester is playing like a star and getting paid like a backup
stories.d: [[p:557716293|G.Priester]] is a 92-overall receiver making nothing in NIL, while players like him make around 130K. In the portal, that gap tends to close quickly.

quote.text: Any receiver would see that gap and ask questions. He's no different.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: M.Carver's coverage skills are going to waste at Penn State, and others see it
stories.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 85-overall coverage safety on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] pass defense that ranks 131st of 138. Programs that play more disciplined coverage have taken notice. Penn State will have to give him a reason to stay.

quote.text: Safeties like him want to sit on top of routes. That's not what's happening in that defense.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

stories.h: Somebody will back up the truck for Slay. Is Bowling Green ready?
stories.d: [[p:557723242|J.Slay]] is an 86-overall quarterback making 15K, while his peers make around 160K. [[t:832438286|Bowling Green]] ranks 134th in NIL spending, so a bidding war is not exactly its specialty.

quote.text: There's money out there for that kind of QB. Bowling Green can't match it.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: A.Cain's role is shrinking on a Penn State defense in crisis against the pass
stories.d: [[p:557718122|A.Cain]] is an 82-overall lurker linebacker. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] ranks 131st of 138 against the pass, and pass defense is where a linebacker like him should make plays. If the defense stays this porous, agerm40 may need to sell him on a fix.

stories.h: Daulton is too good to sit, and quarterback-needy teams know it
stories.d: [[p:557714021|J.Daulton]] is a 90-overall junior quarterback with zero snaps in 12 games. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow, and a few coaches are already thinking about it.

quote.text: He's a quarterback who can win games. He's not going to wait much longer.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: W.Griffin is a 91-overall quarterback getting almost no snaps at Georgia Tech
stories.d: [[p:557727542|W.Griffin]] has played just 97 snaps in 12 games as a junior while sitting No. 2 on the Georgia Tech depth chart. Quarterback-needy programs would start him right away, and the portal is coming.

quote.text: A 91 quarterback sitting on the bench is a gift to anyone who needs one. Someone is going to make the call.
quote.by: a rival recruiting analyst

stories.h: Gado is too good to sit, and Ohio State's tackle issue is back
stories.d: [[p:557712701|R.Gado]] is an 83-overall sophomore tackle with 81 snaps in 12 games. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has not solved his depth chart problem, and someone in the portal would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: He's seen what's happening. He wants a bigger role.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: Green deserves better than 4-8, and contenders will be calling
stories.d: [[p:557727531|T.Green]] is a 90-overall junior safety on an Arkansas team that's 4-8. If he hits the portal, it will be the story of the offseason.

quote.text: A safety like that wants to play in January. Arkansas can't offer that right now.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Hopkins is wasted on a 4-8 Army team and every contender knows it
stories.d: [[p:557724852|R.Hopkins]] is a 90-overall junior quarterback stuck on an Army team that's 4-8. If he enters the portal, he becomes its top prize.

quote.text: Everyone knows his name. Whoever gets the first call has a real shot.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Cobb deserves better than Notre Dame's 4-8, and contenders will call
stories.d: [[p:557715009|M.Cobb]] is an 89-overall junior middle linebacker on a Notre Dame team that's 4-8. Every contender in the country knows his name.

quote.text: He's a real difference-maker on a team that can't use him.
quote.by: a rival staffer
